findings.governingReading: 一斉射撃 is simultaneous shooting/a volley.

findings.highlight: She stops herself from saying that it's almost exactly like Saber's Excalibur.
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーの宝具、エクスカリバーの光そのものではないか、と少女は歯を軋ませる。
findings.governingReading: Sakura grinds her teeth thinking it is like Excalibur's very light.
findings.explanation: Grinding teeth at resemblance becomes suppressing the words.

findings.highlight: Sakura's magical energy capacity is in the billions or even trillions.
findings.evidenceJa: 間桐桜の魔力貯蔵量は数億どころか兆に届く。
findings.governingReading: Not merely several hundred million: reserve reaches trillions.
findings.explanation: Reserve reaching trillions becomes billions or perhaps trillions.

findings.highlight: Even if Rin were to attack until her physical strength failed her, the cave would collapse after.
findings.evidenceJa: 仮に、遠坂凛の体力が尽きるまで攻め続けたとしても、その後に待つものは洞窟の崩壊なのだ。
findings.governingReading: Even if Sakura continues attacking until Rin's stamina ends, cave collapse afterward means Sakura loses.
findings.explanation: Sakura's attrition attack assigned to Rin.

findings.highlight: Sakura screams, knowing it's pointless, the comprehension wringing her neck.
findings.evidenceJa: 無意味と知りながら、自らの首を絞めると理解していながら、間桐桜は叫び続ける。
findings.governingReading: Despite knowing attacks are pointless and strangle her own prospects, Sakura keeps screaming.
findings.explanation: Self-defeating continued action becomes comprehension strangling her.

findings.highlight: Of course I did. Because nobody's ever treated me like one. My hair and my eyes stopped looking like yours. They changed me into a Makiri mage down to my very cells...!"
findings.evidenceJa: 当然です、わたしはもうずっと前から人間扱いされてこなかった。目も髪も姉さんとは変わっていって、細胞の隅々までマキリの魔術師になるよう変えられた……！」
findings.governingReading: She says she has long ceased to receive human treatment, then describes bodily alteration.
findings.explanation: No human treatment for a long time becomes nobody ever treated her as human.

findings.highlight: Rin cuts away the shadows clinging to the crying girl.
findings.evidenceJa: 泣いて縋ってくる少女を、彼女は無言で斬り伏せる。
findings.governingReading: Rin silently cuts down the crying, imploring girl with shadow ruby; image overlays pleading Sakura and her approaching shadow.
findings.explanation: Crying girl/shadow clinging toward Rin becomes shadows clinging to the crying girl.

findings.highlight: Driven back by her sister and denied even a proper fight, the girl materializes more curses in her despair.
findings.evidenceJa: 姉に圧され、戦いを拒否しかけていた少女は、絶望と共に呪いを具現化させていく。
findings.governingReading: Overwhelmed by sister, girl was on point of refusing the fight before despair renews curses.
findings.explanation: Sakura nearly refusing combat becomes Sakura denied a proper fight.

findings.highlight: I've never had a single thing I wanted, but you just keep on insisting on how clean you are...!
findings.evidenceJa: 持っていて欲しかったものを一欠片も持たないクセに、　自分だけはキレイなままだと言い張って—！
findings.governingReading: Continuing address to Rin: you lack even fragment of what I wanted you to possess, yet insist you alone remain clean.
findings.explanation: Qualities Sakura wanted Rin to have become things Sakura never had.

findings.governingReading: Base says not forgive that woman, while ruby reads sister and start of noisy/shut-up.
findings.explanation: Refusal to forgive that woman loses written layer.

findings.highlight: She's been determined to hold out as long as possible.
findings.evidenceJa: 先延ばしにしていた決意を固める。
findings.governingReading: Rin now firms the decision she had postponed, ending wait for Shirou at limit.
findings.explanation: Settling postponed decision becomes earlier determination to keep holding out.
